H4609: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6031: to depress literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (in various applications, as follows)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H7650: to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times)
H5087: to promise (pos., to do or give something to God)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3326: spread, i.e. a bed; (architecture) an extension, i.e. wing or lean-to (a single story or collectively)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H6079: an eyelash (as fluttering); figuratively, morning ray
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H4908: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H3293: a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees)
H7812: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H4496: repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H3548: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
H3847: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H7442: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
H5668: properly, crossed, i.e. (abstractly) transit; used only adverbially, on account of, in order that
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H4899: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H990: the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H3678: properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied)
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H1285: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
H3925: properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H977: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H4186: a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population
H6311: this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence
H6718: the chase; also game (thus taken); (generally) lunch (especially for a journey)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H7646: to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H6779: to sprout (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative)
H7161: a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power
H6186: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
H5216: a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively)
H1322: shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol
H6692: to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish)
H5145: properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty)
